modules.official_rule_year: historical 9A CW through at least 2016; current successor is 9A DX Contest (2025 rules, 2026 calendar)
modules.current_vs_recovered: LogChecker reproduces historical 9A-CW low/high-band and entrant-continent point branches with DXCC entities per band. HRS now schedules the December HF event as 9A DX Contest; its current rules add CW and SSB, six bands, a distinct 40-metre outside-Europe branch, a 2300–0459 UTC two-point bonus, entrant-dependent ITU-zone/province/country multipliers per band and mode, and duplicate enforcement. The old 9A-CW domain is no longer organizer-controlled.
modules.required_fields_and_datasets: A historical implementation would require the applicable archived event-year rules, callsign, Croatian identity, country/continent, six-band frequency, CW mode, and DXCC entity. Current 9A DX additionally requires mode, timestamps, sent and received ITU zones or Croatian province, WAE entities, and multioperator transmitter IDs.

modules.test_status: HRS historical result, current detailed rules, and 2026 calendar evidence recorded; no obsolete runtime rule added
